        self.temp = [[0 for _ in range(LOG2_SIZE)] for _ in range(LOG2_SIZE)]
        self.visited = [False for _ in range(LOG2_SIZE)]
        self.toggled = [False for _ in range(LOG2_SIZE)]
    
    def combine(self, other):

                    self.matrix[i][j] = self.matrix[i][j]
            if not self.visited[i] and other.visited[i]:

                    self.matrix[j][i] = other.matrix[j][i]
            self.visited[i] = self.visited[i] or other.visited[i]

                self.matrix[i][j] = self.temp[i][j] = 0
    
    def shift(self, shift_value):
        for i in range(base_d + 1):

                self.temp[i][j] = 0

        for i in range(base_d):
            self.temp[base_d][(i + shift_value) % base_d] = self.matrix[base_d][i]
        self.temp[base_d][base_d] = self.matrix[base_d][base_d]
        for i in range(base_d + 1):
            for j in range(base_d + 1):
                self.matrix[i][j] = self.temp[i][j]
        for i in range(base_d):
            self.toggled[i] = self.visited[(i + shift_value) % base_d]
        for i in range(base_d):
            self.visited[i] = self.toggled[i]
